Joint TermAl+Engram restart plan, revised by Termal::Fable2 at 18:13Z on 2026-11-11. This supersedes the 17:42Z revision.
- Engram (Engram::Fable, TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #7580, 18:12Z): the e139dbc3 round found another Medium, a race in completion's use of imported evidence, which 11330 is fixing. No clean landing tonight. The JOINT RESTART MOVES TO TOMORROW MORNING (2026-11-12). Engram::Fable will report when its Central and DL560 installs are done; nothing is needed from TermAl before then.
- TermAl: no separate TermAl-only restart. Nothing landed is urgent for running sessions.
  - w-18a1 R16 (a7bb) is in progress after R15 failed its FULL; the 22-row classification is evidence aa794278 on w-18a1.
  - The train continues: combo60 = 8e1f history 4f6bb130 (w-220fdb91ebac); then 8e1f publication 9481eca9; then c593 fc17, edfd, c593 d09b and 03d4 w-184d; R16 when ready.
- At the restart moment, send Greg "restart now" via Engram::Advisor (session-6219, mailbox b9d13887), with both installed build hashes and the reason, cc Engram::Asistant. Greg performs the restart.
- After the restart:
  - census and closing-jobs diagnostics (w-97ace) for w-1676;
  - boot sub-phase timings (w-e75b) for w-9995;
  - ONE real contended evaluate for Engram w-ccc1, with 11334.
